handbookNote: Motorcycle Operator Manual (Motorcycle Safety Foundation, 18th Edition, June 2020, with Supplementary Information for Three-Wheel Motorcycles), distributed as Arkansas's official 'Motorcycle Endorsement Study Guide' -- fetched fresh this session from the official direct PDF link media.ark.org/dps/mom_v16_color_hi_res.pdf, linked from the Arkansas Department of Public Safety / Arkansas State Police driver-examination page (dps.arkansas.gov/law-enforcement/arkansas-state-police/services-programs/driver-examination/), which is itself cited by name and phone number (Motorcycle Safety Coordinator, 501-618-8127) inside the current Arkansas Driver License Study Guide (Vol. 1, Ed. 10, July 2026, media.ark.org/dps/Arkansas-DL-Manual-English-1.pdf) as the source for motorcycle-specific content. Arkansas does not publish a separate state-authored motorcycle manual; like several other states, it distributes the national MSF booklet verbatim (no Arkansas-specific insert pages), so all riding-technique questions are grounded in this national MSF text while all Arkansas-specific licensing facts (Class M/MD license ages, displacement limits, MSF Riders Course skills-test waiver, birth-certificate/parental-signature rule for 16-17 year olds, 1-year knowledge-exam validity, Fort Smith/Warren skills-test sites) are grounded instead in the Class M/MD/Motorized Bicycle Certificate sections and Testing Appointment Types section of the current Arkansas Driver License Study Guide. Price matches this project's established Motorcycle tier ($7.99), not a placeholder. EXAM MECHANICS HEDGED: despite real research across both official manuals and the ASP driver-examination and motorcycle-license web pages, no Arkansas state source publishes the motorcycle knowledge test's exact item count or passing score. Three independent third-party DMV test-prep sources (driving-tests.org, zutobi.com, epermittest.com) consistently and independently report a 25-question test requiring 20 correct (80%) to pass -- this figure is well-corroborated by convergent third-party sources but NOT government-confirmed verbatim for Arkansas's motorcycle test, and must be flagged as such in the EXAM_CONFIGS code comment at wiring time, the same convention used for nc_motorcycle, pa_motorcycle, tx_motorcycle, al_motorcycle, and mn_motorcycle. Content-depth rationale: the MSF manual is a full, substantive 58-page national booklet (gear, vehicle control, SEE strategy, intersections, conspicuity, crash avoidance, dangerous surfaces, mechanical problems, animals/flying objects, passengers/cargo, group riding with hand signals, alcohol/cannabis/fatigue, and a complete three-wheel motorcycle and sidecar supplement) plus a distinct Arkansas licensing chapter, comfortably supporting a rich, non-repetitive 214-question bank after the build pipeline's dedup step, all traceable to specific manual sections and page numbers.
